observations: Retail box for an 'FM RADIO HOME THEATER WITH DVD'.
Model number 'HT-505' is clearly printed on the box in photo 0.
The box illustration shows four tall 'tallboy' speakers and one central unit (subwoofer/player).
Features listed include Bluetooth (BT), DVD/CD playback, and FM radio.
A '2022 NEW' sticker and a '1 Year Pan Africa Warranty' logo are visible on the box.
No manufacturer brand name is clearly legible on the box.
The actual physical items are not shown; only the packaging is visible.
Watermark 'BLESSED KEY MOORE' appears to be the seller's name.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows four tall speakers on the box illustration.
The box shows one main unit which typically serves as both the player and the subwoofer (woofer); 'base' and 'woofer' usually refer to the same component.
These items are not shown in the photo.
The box illustration shows 4 satellite speakers and 1 main unit (4.1 configuration). A 5.1 system requires a 5th satellite speaker.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain different/damaged items.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual speakers and player out of the box.
risks.if_unproven: as an empty box or parts only

risks.risk: The brand is likely a generic or low-end manufacturer, affecting durability and sound quality.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand logo on the front of the main unit.

risks.risk: The system may not be fully functional (e.g., dead channels, faulty DVD laser).
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powered on and playing audio through all speakers.

risks.risk: Missing 5th speaker for a true 5.1 setup.
risks.proof: A photo showing all 5 satellite speakers and the subwoofer together.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual speakers and main unit outside of the box.
Close-up photo of the brand name on the main unit.
Photo of all included accessories (remote, cables, and all speakers).
Video of the system powered on and playing audio.
response.reason: Only the retail packaging is shown, not the actual item. The brand is unidentified, and the speaker configuration on the box (4.1) contradicts the seller's claim of 5.1.
